title: Similar: Reservoir Evaporation Driver Attribution
goal: Analyze a reservoir monitoring dataset to determine whether warm-season evaporation has intensified over time, then classify all candidate predictors into Heat, Flow, Wind, and Human groups and report the dominant category with its contribution percentage.
skillBenefitRationale: This stays close to the source task’s attribution pattern, but shifts from lake temperature to reservoir evaporation so the key challenge remains grouping mixed hydro-meteorological variables into the four driver classes before estimating category-level importance.
